name: Nike Atlético Kids Training Dri-Fit Strike

description.tagline: Train with the intensity of Atleti
description.intro: The Nike Atlético de Madrid Dri-Fit Strike training children's shirt has been designed for young footballers to train with the same equipment used by Atlético de Madrid players during preparation sessions for the 2026 2027 season. Its striking design and Nike Dri-FIT technology help maintain freshness and comfort even in the most demanding training sessions.
key_benefits: Nike Dri-FIT Technology: Wicks sweat away to keep skin dry and comfortable.
Strike Design: High performance training line used by professional players.
Classic fit: Freedom of movement to train without limits.
Lightweight, breathable fabric: Keeps you cool during intense workouts.
Atlético de Madrid Style: Club details for an authentic look on and off the field.
